seoDescription: See the Adams 12 2025-2026 calendar with the August 12 first day, May 21 last day, breaks, quarter endings, staff workdays, orientation, and official PDF.
heroSummary: Adams 12 Five Star Schools starts all students on Tuesday, August 12, 2025. Sixth- and ninth-grade orientation is August 11, except at K-8 schools. The last student day and end of Quarter 4 are May 21, 2026. The calendar also marks four weeklong breaks and staff workdays throughout the year.
calendarNotes: This PDF is dated January 16, 2025 and marked subject to revision. April 13 and May 4 are district staff-workday dates, but high schools may select a different day in the corresponding month. Families should verify those dates with the high school before arranging care or travel.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Adams 12 start school in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: All students begin Tuesday, August 12, 2025. Sixth- and ninth-grade orientation is August 11, except at K-8 schools.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Adams 12 Fall Break in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break runs October 13-17, 2025, after Quarter 1 ends October 10.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Adams 12 Winter Break in 2025-26?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 22, 2025 through January 2, 2026. January 5 is a student no-school staff workday.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of Adams 12 school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The last student day and end of Quarter 4 are Thursday, May 21, 2026. The staff last day is May 22.

calendarFaqs.q: Can an Adams 12 high school use different staff workdays?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. The PDF says high schools may choose different dates for the listed April 13 and May 4 staff workdays.
